question: author, 2026-11-08: model the one-member economy for the regions that pass the first-region screen

rules_tested.12b.2: imports paid by exports over five years, no new debt
rules_tested.12b.4: reserve of at least six months of essential imports
rules_tested.T-1.2/T-1.3: savings convert at basket parity; the cap applies to wealth held on the voting day

evidence.trade, reserves, remittances, GDP: World Bank WDI, latest year 2015-2024, frozen with hashes (VERIFIED_OFFICIAL)
evidence.essential import share: food + fuel + ores and metals, % of merchandise imports (WDI); a floor: medicines and needs equipment are not in the series
evidence.price level: PPP conversion factor / official exchange rate (WDI); 1 = US price level
evidence.top of scale: WDI income shares of the top 10% and 20%; Pareto tail fitted to the top decile (MODEL_DERIVED); the UNIRA base basket vs the region's mean from V7.4

limits: a stock-flow of foreign currency with fixed shocks; no behavioural response of exporters, no capital account
the export shock stands for partners' reactions and lost competitiveness while internal prices move to the world hour price; its size is a scenario, not an estimate
the price wedge is an economy-wide average; the smuggling incentive is good by good
Pareto tail from two income shares: the share above the ceiling is an order of magnitude, not a count
remittances are assumed to continue; they would fall if emigrants' families no longer need them, or rise
